title: MCP Inspector
subtitle: Interactive testing and debugging interface for MCP servers
noServerSelectedDesc: Please select an MCP server from the dropdown above to start inspecting its capabilities and testing its functionality.
connectToStart: Connect to MCP server to start inspecting
selectServerDesc: Please select a server to inspect

pingComponent.title: Server Connectivity Test
pingComponent.noPingHistory: No ping history yet. Click "Ping Server" to test connectivity.
pingComponent.aboutPingDescription: The ping test checks if the MCP server is responsive. It first tries the standard "ping" method, and if that's not available, falls back to testing with "tools/list" to verify the server is reachable. Response times help assess server performance.

promptsComponent.title: Prompts
promptsComponent.promptsNotSupportedDesc: This MCP server doesn't support prompts.
promptsComponent.clickLoadPrompts: Click "Load Prompts" to fetch available prompts from the MCP server.
promptsComponent.noPromptsFound: No prompts found on MCP server
promptsComponent.selectPrompt: Select a prompt to view its result
promptsComponent.clickGetPrompt: Click "Get Prompt" to retrieve the result for "{{promptName}}"
promptsComponent.aboutPromptsDesc: Prompts are reusable templates that can generate messages for AI conversations. They can accept arguments to customize the generated content and help maintain consistent interactions across different contexts.
promptsComponent.audioNotSupported: Your browser does not support the audio element.

resourcesComponent.resourcesNotSupportedDesc: This MCP server doesn't support resources.
resourcesComponent.clickLoadResources: Click "Load Resources" to fetch available resources from the MCP server.
resourcesComponent.selectResource: Select a resource to view its content
resourcesComponent.clickRead: Click "Read" to load the content of "{{resourceName}}"
resourcesComponent.aboutResourcesDesc: Resources provide access to data that the MCP server can read. This includes files, web content, databases, or any other data sources. You can subscribe to resources to receive notifications when they change.
resourcesComponent.noResourcesFound: No resources found on MCP server
resourcesComponent.fetchResourcesError: Failed to fetch resources from MCP server
resourcesComponent.fetchTemplatesError: Failed to fetch resource templates from MCP server
resourcesComponent.noResourceTemplatesFound: No resource templates found on MCP server

toolsComponent.toolsNotSupportedWarning: Tools capability not available on this server
toolsComponent.clickListTools: Click "List Tools" to load available tools
toolsComponent.noExecutions: No executions yet. Select a tool and execute it to see results.
toolsComponent.invalidJsonDescription: Please check your JSON syntax and try again.

inspectorFilter.searchPlaceholder: Search tools by name or description...

inspectorForm.fillHelp: Paste a JSON object whose keys are this tool's parameters
inspectorForm.notAnObject: That text is not a JSON object.
inspectorForm.missingRequired: Required fields not set: {{fields}}. The call will probably be rejected.
inspectorForm.warnNotNumber: Typed text is not a number; sent as a string
inspectorForm.warnNotBoolean: Typed text is not true or false; sent as a string

inspectorResult.imageNotShown: Image not shown (type {{mimeType}} is not displayed)
inspectorResult.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard
inspectorResult.stopWaitingHelp: Requests cancellation and stops this page waiting. The backend may still finish the call.
inspectorResult.outcomeUnknown: The request ended without a result. The backend may still have completed it. For a write, read the target before retrying.
inspectorResult.stoppedNote: Stopped waiting after {{ms}}ms. Cancellation was requested; the backend may still finish the call.

inspectorTarget.label: Target:
inspectorTarget.select: Select a server, namespace or endpoint...
inspectorTarget.gatewayNote: Connected through the gateway's namespace route with your admin session. Tools are listed and called as the namespace serves them: names, filtering, overrides and retired-tool handling are applied. Tool calls are real and are recorded in the audit log as admin session calls. Each connection opens one session per backend server in the namespace until you leave this page.
inspectorTarget.endpointNote: Preview of the namespace, not of the endpoint. You selected the endpoint "{{endpoint}}", but this connection is made to its namespace "{{namespace}}". Nothing configured on the endpoint is applied: not its title or instructions, listing mode or output trimming, and not its authentication, access groups or rate limits. To test those, connect to the public endpoint with a real client.
inspectorTarget.includeInactiveHelp: Clients never see inactive servers. Turn this on to inspect them.

inspectorServerInfo.name: Name
inspectorServerInfo.title: Title
inspectorServerInfo.gatewayNote: This is the namespace server's own initialize result, read through the admin route. Anything configured on an endpoint, such as its title or instructions, is not part of it. Connect to the public endpoint with a real client to see what that endpoint announces.

inspectorTraffic.title: JSON-RPC traffic
inspectorTraffic.subtitle: Messages sent and received on this connection.
inspectorTraffic.omitBodiesHelp: On by default. The file then holds methods, ids, timing and error codes only. Turn it off to include the full messages.
inspectorTraffic.truncated: Message larger than {{limit}} bytes; the body was not kept ({{bytes}} bytes)
inspectorTraffic.privacyNote: This log is not saved by the server. It stays in this browser tab until you leave the page or connect again, and it holds tool arguments and results exactly as exchanged. Tool calls are still recorded in the gateway's audit log.
